series_note: Fresh 3-run series produced entirely on LOCAL_DEVICE=K_lipvoice by this capsule's own harness. It supersedes the earlier LOCAL_K_LIPVOICE_NEW_SERIES run1/run2/run3 evidence, which is retained only as historical evidence and is NOT accepted. The recut exists because that earlier series sampled P03's keeper inside its authored finite `out` transient (a fixed 120ms settle against a 180ms setTimeout plus a .55s transition), so Pair 15 recorded the keeper figure visible on one side and absent on the other, and the comparator absorbed that into an allowed projection instead of measuring it. No source repair was made and none is required: the ORIGINAL inline script and the SPLIT external script are byte-identical (SHA-256 feebaa6f...), as are the CSS halves.

capture_method.note: P03 scene_01/initial states wait for #keeper to leave its authored finite transient (exists, complete, naturalWidth>0, no `out` class, displayed, opacity 1, no running keeper CSSTransition) plus a 2-rAF settle, with an 8000ms bounded timeout that FAILS CLOSED. The wait is scoped to #keeper only: it never waits on all animations, on infinite/live animations, or on any global page settle. All other states keep the original fixed 120ms settle.

comparator_method.note: CSSTransitions are compared by structural signature (target, transitionProperty, duration, delay, iterations, easing). A transient may be projected as AUTHORED_FINITE_TRANSIENT_PHASE ONLY when both sides agree on that structure; any structural delta - including an empty ORIGINAL target set against a populated SPLIT one - is recorded as an UNCLASSIFIED residual and fails the run. Only capture-phase fields (currentTime, playState) are projected.
